        print(f"Color {color}: {len(nodes)} nodes")
        for n in nodes:
            boundary = n['boundary']
            min_r = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
            max_r = max(p[0] for p in boundary)
            min_c = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
            max_c = max(p[1] for p in boundary)
            print(f"  Node {n['id']}: rows {min_r}-{max_r}, cols {min_c}-{max_c}, pixels={n['pixels']}")
    else:
        print(f"Color {color}: {len(nodes)} nodes (too many to list)")

# Check adjacency
print(f"\nAdjacency list entries: {len(seg['adjacency_list'])}")
